en.title: Belton Seeks Public Input on ADA Accessibility Plan Amid Local Accessibility Updates
en.summary: The City of Belton is soliciting public feedback on its ADA Transition Plan to improve accessibility for residents with disabilities. Meanwhile, Marvel's Wolverine is set to launch September 15 with over 100 accessibility options, while Evanston's dog beach ramp project faces cost overruns and the DNR removed an accessibility mat from Heather Beach after vandalism. Additionally, a discussion on X highlights how people with disabilities use the platform's monetization features to support living expenses.

zh-TW.title: 貝爾頓徵求公眾意見 ADA 無障礙計畫，關注地方無障礙進展
zh-TW.summary: 貝爾頓市正徵求公眾對其ADA過渡計畫的意見，以改善殘障居民的無障礙環境。同時，Marvel《金鋼狼》將於9月15日推出，提供超過100項無障礙選項；埃文斯頓的狗海灘坡道計畫因經費上升受阻，DNR則因屢遭破壞移除Heather Beach的無障礙墊。此外，X平台上的討論顯示，殘障使用者利用變現功能幫助支付團體住宅租金。
